Contract Generator.contract:
Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::generateLoanAgreement(): Boolean {
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanAgreement.oclIsUndefined() = true
	postcondition:
		let newAgreement: LoanAgreement in
		newAgreement.Content = "Loan Agreement" and
		CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanAgreement = newAgreement and
		LoanAgreement.allInstance()->includes(newAgreement) and
		result = true
}
